clue.text: Dandified leaders of fashion often produce expression of disgust

indicators.note: the leaders of the next three words are their opening letters, taken in order

parts.note: pish is an old exclamation of contempt or disgust

explanation.surface: Top fashion figures pull a face at something distasteful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaders of' takes the first letters of fashion, often and produce, giving F, O, P, before PISH.
explanation.definitionFit: A dandy is a man vain about his clothes, and foppish describes that same showy vanity.

clue.text: Aspects of a girl's best friend?

definitions.text: Aspects of a girl's best friend?

parts.words: Aspects of a girl's best friend?
parts.note: diamonds are a girl's best friend, and the cut faces of a gem are its aspects

explanation.surface: A question about the qualities of a woman's closest companion.
explanation.walkthrough: The song says diamonds are a girl's best friend; the cut faces of a diamond are its aspects.
explanation.definitionFit: The flat polished surfaces of a cut gem are its sides, and figuratively a matter's sides or angles.

clue.text: Fill up net liberally, being generous

indicators.note: liberally means freely, so the letters are moved about freely

explanation.surface: A fisherman fills his net to the brim in a lavish mood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'liberally' rearranges the nine letters of FILL UP NET; 'being' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: Generous here means ample or abundant, as in a generous helping.

clue.text: Slight suspicion of liquid some molluscs eject over fish

indicators.note: over in a down clue says the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: squid and octopus squirt ink
a ling is a long fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A diver half suspects that squid are squirting at a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A faint notion or hint that something is so is a vague suspicion.

clue.text: How to take the plunge, after the boss

definitions.meaning: diving in with the top of the body leading
with the chief going first and you following behind

explanation.definitionFit: Plunging with the head leading is diving in, and literally the head going first means the leader ahead.

clue.text: Going round a bit with men for a change

indicators.note: for a change says the letters of the preceding words are to be altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone tours a short while with a group of men just to vary the routine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a change' rearranges A, BIT and MEN; 'with' only joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambient air or sound is what surrounds you, encircling the place you stand.

clue.text: Stories about soldiers in a scene of conflict

indicators.note: about says the stories go round the soldiers

parts.note: ana is a collection of anecdotes or stories
RE are the Royal Engineers, British Army soldiers

explanation.surface: Tales of troops caught up in a battle.
explanation.walkthrough: ANA, the suffix for collected sayings (Victoriana), is a crossword staple for stories; 'in' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: An amphitheatre where gladiators fought, and by extension any field of contest.

clue.text: Irish spirit is poison, a woman held

indicators.note: held says the poison wraps round the woman

parts.note: bane is an old word for poison
she stands for a woman

explanation.surface: A spirit in Irish legend is a poison clutched by a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a woman' gives the pronoun, not A plus a letter; 'is' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: In Irish folklore she is the female spirit whose wailing foretells a death.

clue.text: A number raise the roof, to some extent

indicators.note: to some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A crowd making a lot of noise at a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'number' is read as something that numbs: an old anaesthetic.
explanation.definitionFit: This anaesthetic gas deadens feeling, so it is a numbing agent.

clue.text: Lack of courage to lift it — I had it in my grasp

indicators.note: lift in a down clue raises the word upward, reading it backwards

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in with grasp says the letters sit inside the word gripping them
grasp says the pronoun holds the other letters within its grip

parts.note: taken as written
I had shortens to I'd
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to cowardice: they had the chance in their hands and did not raise it.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'lift' reverses upward; 'in ... grasp' is split around 'my', which is the container; 'to' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: Timidity is shyness and fearfulness, an absence of bravery.

clue.text: Sound European partner winning position on board

indicators.note: Sound at the start says the next word is to be heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a Czech is a European from the Czech Republic
a mate is a partner or companion

explanation.surface: A healthy Continental companion holds a strong hand at a board game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like 'healthy' but asks for CZECH said aloud, which gives CHECK.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess the winning position traps the opposing king with no escape.

clue.text: For this prophet to err might indeed be human

indicators.note: to err is to go astray, so the letters of the next word wander out of order

explanation.surface: A play on the proverb that to err is human, offered as an excuse for a prophet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to err' scrambles the letters of HUMAN; 'might indeed be' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: He is a minor prophet of the Old Testament, with a short book named after him.

clue.text: The players collectively take nearly half the ice-cream

indicators.note: nearly half keeps only the front part of the ice cream's name, a little under half its letters

parts.note: ...-frutti is an ice cream studded with candied fruit

explanation.surface: An orchestra shares out most of half a tub of ice cream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nearly half' keeps the first five of the eleven letters of TUTTIFRUTTI; 'take' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: In music the marking instructs all the performers to play together, the whole ensemble.

clue.text: Like a flier whose cover is down

definitions.text: Like a flier whose cover is down

parts.words: Like a flier whose cover is down
parts.note: down reads as soft plumage rather than lowered, so the flier is a bird coated in plumage

explanation.surface: An aviator whose disguise has slipped.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird's covering of down and quills is its plumage, so the bird is clad in plumes.

clue.text: Possible description of a skate? It's not for an angler to say

definitions.text: Possible description of a skate? It's not for an angler to say

parts.words: Possible description of a skate? It's not for an angler to say
parts.note: a skater traces a looping shape on ice, while a skate is also a fish, and anglers notoriously exaggerate the size of their catch

explanation.surface: A fishing story that admits anglers cannot be trusted on the size of a skate.
explanation.walkthrough: The fish skate sends you to angling, but the shape is one an ice skater carves; the angler would not name a modest number like eight for his fish's weight.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names a looping two-circle pattern traced on ice, and also a modest weight for a fish.

clue.text: Old union leader taunted and duped

indicators.note: the leader of union is its first letter

parts.note: twitted means teased or taunted

explanation.surface: An elderly trade union boss was mocked and conned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader' takes the U from union; 'and' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: To be duped is to be tricked by someone cleverer, beaten in a battle of wits.

clue.text: Good to join battle again — it should bear fruit

parts.note: to re-engage is to fight once more

explanation.surface: A rallying call to fight again in the hope of reward.
explanation.definitionFit: The tree of that name yields a green plum, so it is one that bears fruit.

clue.text: Controversial description of a cricket match?

definitions.meaning: having two opposing views, open to argument
a match is played by two teams, or sides

explanation.definitionFit: A matter with two opposed views is disputed, and a game between two teams has two halves.

clue.text: .Add an ounce, perhaps, to pound, in unofficial action

parts.note: an ounce is the snow leopard, an example of a big cat living wild
to pound is to hit, as is to strike

explanation.surface: A recipe instruction to add an ounce to a pound turns into a call for industrial protest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ounce' and 'pound' look like weights; the ounce is the snow leopard and pound means hit.
explanation.definitionFit: An unofficial stoppage of work, called without union backing, is the classic industrial action of that kind.

clue.text: Commander short-changed military units

parts.note: CO is the Commanding Officer

indicators.note: changed says the letters of short are rearranged

explanation.surface: An officer is cheated in dealing with army units.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short-changed' looks like 'cheated', but the hyphen hides an anagram indicator on its first half.
explanation.definitionFit: Roman legions were divided into ten units of soldiers, each a body of troops.

clue.text: Man is so narrow-minded!

definitions.meaning: the Isle of Man is an island, so it has island character

explanation.definitionFit: Islanders are cut off, and the word now means having a narrow, inward outlook.

clue.text: Respectable City district in grip of depression

indicators.note: in grip of says the hollow holds the district inside it

parts.note: a dent is a hollow or depression
EC is the London postal district covering the City of London

explanation.surface: A respectable part of the City is in the throes of an economic slump.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's financial district, whose postcodes begin with those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Decent describes behaviour that is proper and acceptable, worthy of respect.

clue.text: After spring. US billionaire reportedly set course for Italy

parts.note: a spa is a mineral spring

indicators.note: reportedly says the billionaire's name is to be heard, not spelt

parts.note: J. Paul Getty was a famously rich American oil magnate

explanation.surface: Once spring arrives, a rich American is said to head off for Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' sets the spring first; J. Paul Getty's name said aloud matches the Italian ending.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasta is the standard Italian first course, and this long thin noodle is the best known.

clue.text: Daughter embraced by a fellow publicist

indicators.note: embraced by says the daughter sits inside the following words

parts.note: a man is a fellow

explanation.surface: A young woman is hugged by a man who works in public relations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embraced by' puts D inside A MAN.
explanation.definitionFit: An advertising man promotes products, working in publicity.

clue.text: It's black and sticky — don't step on it

definitions.meaning: like pitch or bitumen, coated with road tar
step on it means hurry, so this means linger or delay

explanation.definitionFit: Covered in pitch is the first sense; to linger rather than hurry is the second.

clue.text: Burn with anger, perhaps — when rebuffed, for example

parts.note: anger is one of the seven deadly sins

indicators.note: rebuffed means pushed back, so the abbreviation is read backwards

explanation.surface: Someone smoulders with rage after being snubbed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anger' is an example of a deadly sin, signalled by 'perhaps'; 'with' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: To scorch something lightly on the surface is to char it slightly, a mild burn.

clue.text: Raise objections, being mostly sober and reserved

indicators.note: mostly says the word loses its final letter

parts.note: demure means modest, sober and reserved in manner

explanation.surface: A quiet, abstemious person still finds things to complain about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the last E of DEMURE; 'being' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: To demur is to voice hesitation or protest against a proposal.

clue.text: Counter-attack I delayed, coming back in charge

indicators.note: in says the reversed letters go inside the word for charge

parts.note: a rate is a charge or fee

indicators.note: coming back says the pair of words is to be read from end to start

parts.note: late means delayed or behind time

explanation.surface: A soldier admits holding back before the return assault on the commanding position.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charge' looks military beside 'Counter-attack' but means a price.
explanation.definitionFit: To strike back after being attacked is to repay the injury, a counter-strike.

clue.text: Line of rulers finding its own extremes objectionable

parts.note: the solution's own first and last letters, D and Y, placed together
nasty means unpleasant or objectionable

explanation.surface: A royal house cannot stand its own fringe members.
explanation.walkthrough: 'its own extremes' is self-referential: the first and last letters of the solution itself, put at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: A succession of rulers from one family, such as the Tudors, is a ruling house.

clue.text: Experienced peacekeepers initially departing for river up North

indicators.note: initially departing says the letters leave from the start of the word

parts.note: underwent means experienced or went through
UN, the United Nations, sends peacekeeping forces

explanation.surface: Veteran peacekeeping troops set off early for a northern river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially departing' removes UN from the front of UNDERWENT.
explanation.definitionFit: The Derwent is a river in northern England, in Cumbria and also in Yorkshire, a northern watercourse.
